scope: Fixed C09/SU-02: existing positive16384-byte header bound before length-based read.
One lossless early exit in existing receipt context preparation after first maximal overlap; no new representation, dropped data, cache, model or tool route.
qualityGates: Same exact whole prepared provider input bytes, including instructions, tool schemas, origin/person source data, receipts, failure/stop fields and reference hashes.
Same overlap result and tie ordering against unchanged original, including Unicode, escaped text, repetitions, partial spans, empty/small input and no-match.
No mutation, cross-request reuse or shared private state. Existing privacy, cancellation and receipt tests remain intact.
Portable valid authenticated archive yields same validated contents; malformed size stops before body read; bad passphrase/truncation/AAD/canonical checks retain behavior.

workloads: ordinary source/tool result with repeated literal in JSON envelope
retained saved artifact with readback wrapper
short ordinary context with no long repeated text
measurements.ordering: Alternate reference and candidate to reduce drift; no rerun to chase a greener score.
record: prepared input bytes and local tokenizer count
quality exact-equality and source mutation check
portable bytes read and elapsed/memory measurements where measurable
measurements.adoption: Adopt only exact output equality for all cases plus positive reproducible relevant preparation gain; a noisy/regressing ordinary workload is explicitly reported. Do not turn CPU-time gain into a claim of total task/answer latency or fewer billed tokens.

budget.purpose: Measure deterministic work before any provider call; exact same request input does not need another paid model answer for this implementation-equivalence decision.

independence: Other executor reviews early-exit proof and fixed header behavior; developer does not modify protected final-evaluation data or scores.
